featured_reviews.name: Vignesh Balaji
featured_reviews.review_text:
The Bollywood Art Project (BAP) is a vibrant tribute to Mumbai’s rich cinematic history, transforming the city’s streets into an open-air gallery of stunning Bollywood-inspired murals. Located primarily in Bandra, these larger-than-life artworks celebrate legendary actors, iconic movie moments, and the essence of Indian cinema.

Each mural is meticulously crafted, capturing the expressions, colors, and nostalgia of Bollywood’s golden era. From Amitabh Bachchan’s towering presence to Madhubala’s timeless charm, every piece tells a story that resonates with movie lovers and art enthusiasts alike. The detailing and scale of the murals make them a visual delight and a must-visit for photographers and Instagrammers.

Beyond just art, BAP serves as a cultural movement, blending Mumbai’s love for cinema with street art. Walking through the painted lanes of Bandra, one can truly appreciate how Bollywood is not just an industry but an emotion for millions.

If you’re in Mumbai, taking a stroll through the Bollywood Art Project is a unique and immersive way to experience the city’s artistic and cinematic soul. Highly recommended! 🎥🎨✨

There were times when i used to hold back thinking ‘ye chalega’ and santosh used to disagree and get it done just the way it should be. We did the entire project at peak monsoon and Colorwale made sure we have the latest equipments and materials to get the walls dried faster, water proof better and get the job done in less than a week. Its time to break our parent’s myth that everything online is expensive and non reliable. I would highly recommend Colorwale to everyone.
